map.牙龈指数(GI)与出血指数评估器 使用指南: Gingival Index (GI) and Bleeding Index Assessor User Guide
map.基于 Loe & Silness 牙龈指数(GI)与探诊出血(BOP)，评估牙龈: Based on the Loe & Silness gingival index (GI) and bleeding on probing (BOP), assesses the degree of gingival inflammation. Four points are recorded per tooth: mesio-buccal/labial, buccal/labial, disto-buccal/labial and lingual/palatal.
map.基于 Loe &amp; Silness 牙龈指数(GI)与探诊出血(BOP)，: Based on the Loe & Silness gingival index (GI) and bleeding on probing (BOP), assesses the degree of gingival inflammation. Four points are recorded per tooth: mesio-buccal/labial, buccal/labial, disto-buccal/labial and lingual/palatal.
map.牙周初诊按牙位记录龈色、质、出血，工具汇总 GI 均值并分级炎症。: At a first periodontal visit, record gum colour, texture and bleeding by tooth position, and the tool aggregates the mean GI and grades the inflammation.
map.洁治后复查 BOP 阳性率下降，量化炎症改善。: After scaling, the BOP positive rate falls on review, quantifying the improvement in inflammation.
map.正畸固定矫治期间监测龈炎，提示加强邻面清洁。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考: Monitor gingivitis during fixed orthodontic treatment and recommends better interproximal cleaning. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, and do not replace oral examination, imaging such as periapical films/CBCT, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists and periodontists; for toothache, bleeding gums, ulcers that do not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, see a hospital dental department promptly.)
map.：输入：6 个牙位 GI 评分 [0,1,1,2,1,0]\n计算：GI 均值:
: Input: GI scores for 6 tooth positions [0,1,1,2,1,0]
Calculation: mean GI = (0+1+1+2+1+0)/6, about 0.83, meaning mild gingivitis
Note: the higher the score the more severe the inflammation, judged together with the BOP positive rate.
map.牙龈指数(GI)怎么分？: How is the gingival index GI graded?
map.Loe & Silness 法：0 正常，1 轻度炎症，2 中度（红肿、探诊出血: Loe & Silness method: 0 normal, 1 mild inflammation, 2 moderate (redness, swelling, bleeding on probing), 3 severe (spontaneous bleeding, ulceration). Recorded per tooth surface.
map.Bleeding on Probing，探诊出血，是牙龈炎症的敏感指标；阳性率高: Bleeding on Probing, a sensitive indicator of gingival inflammation; a high positive rate means the periodontal tissue is in an active inflammatory phase.
